head: bb0956b5dddfd5a7134fcc5c9835ab6d97a86f94
expression_benchmark_difference: Only the perf helper comment differs; executable benchmark statements and line numbers are unchanged.

method.fixed_comparison: Before/after the untyped-empty-aggregate-NULL simplification hook, plus the saved expression/ROUND control. All share the four existing subquery/LATERAL repairs and ROUND/filter fixes.
method.planning_scope: SQL parsing, Sail analysis/resolution, DataFusion logical/physical optimization and physical-plan construction in an already registered in-memory session. No table registration or I/O.
method.execution_scope: Consume a fresh physical plan per execution, including scalar subqueries, hash-join build/probe, COUNT/NULL compensation and required sorts. Planning and plan destruction are outside execution timing.
method.counter_scope: Native FIFO counts either nine planning calls or nine executions, excluding setup, full-row validation, warmups and the other phase. Plans are retained until counters stop.
method.retention: All raw timing samples retained. Full-suite samples and selected-case counter runs remain separate.
method.limits: One deterministic in-memory fixture, one machine and one partition. No Delta I/O or concurrent workloads; separate planning/execution phases are not measured end-to-end SQL latency. Invalid pre-repair queries are diagnostics, not performance baselines.

proof_scope: Only the untyped NULL emitted by empty-aggregate evaluation is simplified. Typed SQL NULL and COUNT zero retain their argument expressions; existing CAST/subquery errors are preserved.

rejected_general_null_rule.reason: Simplifying every typed/untyped literal NULL suppressed two ANSI invalid-CAST errors reported by Spark. The final rule only handles the untyped empty-aggregate sentinel.

unit_check.baseline_failure: The untyped-NULL case remains a ScalarFunction instead of a typed NULL literal.
